title: ailanthus integrifolia subsp. calycina
intro: Ailanthus integrifolia subsp. calycina, commonly known as Chinese tree of heaven or Manchurian tree of heaven, is a plant species within the Simaroubaceae family. The Chinese tree of heaven is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in the treatment of fever, diarrhea, and respiratory issues. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as ailanthone and ailanthin, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including analgesic and anti-inflammatory effects.
